newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela oil investment tax rebate bill now ready.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela oil investment tax rebate bill now ready.

text.p: Delays in the passage of a key Venezuelan tax law that threatened to hold-up billions of dollars in oil investments have been overcome and the law will be approved later this month, tax superintendency SENIAT told Reuters.
"The law will go to the economic cabinet for approval this week, said SENIAT President Edgar Paredes Pisani.
The law exempts companies from paying a 16.5 percent tax on the start-up costs of capital intensive projects in key sectors, such as oil, mining, pulp, forestry and petrochemicals.
Although the tax exemption was approved by congress in July, the enabling mechanism that supported it was not. Delays left planned multi-billion dollar investments hanging, according to oil sources.
Paredes Pisani said the law would provide for a five year tax exemption at the start of a project and would apply equally to national and international companies.
